description: This Java class, JREChecker, is a utility class that provides a method to determine if the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) is running in 32-bit mode by inspecting system properties.

classes.name: JREChecker
classes.description: A utility class containing methods for JVM parameter checks, specifically to identify if the JVM is 32-bit.

methods.name: is32bit
methods.description: Checks system properties to determine if the JVM is running in 32-bit mode and returns true if so.
